description: Body of the forward route: copy a message into another channel or thread.

attachments.description: Copy the source's files too (S15; default `true`). `false` forwards the text only.

body.description: An optional comment, at most 16 KiB.

nonce.description: A client nonce, 1–64 characters, echoed back (S13).

suppress_previews.description: Build no link previews for the forward's comment (S16).

title: ForwardMessageRequest
